meta.name: bigquery
meta.description: Query and manage Google BigQuery datasets using the bq CLI and REST API. Run SQL queries, export results, manage tables and datasets in BigQuery.

copy.tagline: 用 SQL 查询和管理云端数据仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要用 SQL 分析大数据
copy.tagline_en: Query and manage cloud data warehouses with SQL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you analyze large datasets with SQL

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以用 bq 命令行或 REST API 对 Google BigQuery 运行 SQL 查询、导出结果,并管理表和数据集合。
howto.when: 当用户要求对 Google BigQuery 运行 SQL 查询、导出结果,或管理表和数据集合时触发。

say.text: 用 bq 查询 my_dataset.users 前 10 行
say.note: 会运行 bq query 并返回 JSON 结果。

say.text: 把 my_dataset.users 查询结果导出成 CSV
say.note: 会导出为 CSV 文件。

say.text: 在 BigQuery 新建数据集 my_new_dataset
say.note: 会执行 bq mk 创建数据集。

howto.what_en: Claude can query and manage Google BigQuery datasets using the bq CLI and the REST API: run SQL queries, export results, and manage tables and datasets in BigQuery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to run SQL queries on BigQuery, export query results, or manage tables and datasets (e.g., create, copy, delete).

say_en.text: Use bq to query first 10 rows of my_dataset.users
say_en.note: Claude runs the query and returns JSON.

say_en.text: Export my_dataset.users query results to CSV
Create a new BigQuery dataset my_new_dataset
say_en.note: Claude runs bq mk to create it.
